records.text: Range Day Bro said footage clearly showed Charlie Kirk being shot from the back right, with blood splatter coming from the entry wound.
records.speaker: Range Day Bro

appearances.snippet: So in this footage, you can clearly see that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) is shot from his back right and there is blood splatter coming out of the entry wound.

verification.notes: The episode directly plays Range Day Bro saying that the footage clearly showed Kirk shot from the back right and what he described as blood splatter from an entry wound. This verifies the attributed statement that he said it; it does not independently validate his ballistic interpretation. Owens immediately disputed the blood-splatter identification in the same transcript.

records.text: Range Day Bro said a blurry image looked like a person holding a rifle rather than merely a bush.
records.speaker: Range Day Bro

appearances.snippet: It looks like there is a person right here and it looks like there is a rifle right here that that person is holding. ... A hand here, support hand sort of— Very blurry image, but you can clearly make out this is not just a bush.

verification.notes: The episode directly plays Range Day Bro describing the blurry image as appearing to show a person holding a rifle and saying it was not just a bush. This verifies the attribution of his stated interpretation, not the underlying image identification, which remains an opinion based on a blurry image.
